font.$description: Font-family + stat-face INTENT only — the neutral source carries the family stack; each consumer bundles its own binaries (woff2 in the web repos, ttf/otf in native). --font-front-door (Sometype Mono, SUR-508) must stay in lockstep across every emit.

stat.$description: ⚠ PROVISIONAL — stat-box number face. Current value = the existing .stat-value serif. The Braird Screens.html import (Deliverable 2) sets the final value; the token exists now so surfc can reference var(--font-stat) without re-plumbing.
